$comment: Checkout, account and the configurator: LCP <= 2.5s, initial JS <= 200 KB. Signed out, which is the heavier render for sign-in and the empty state for the rest. RATCHET: the target in docs/performance-budgets.md is 200 KB of initial JS; the shell alone measures ~254 KB, account/sign-in 254–268 KB and the configurator 283 KB (F3 3.2 — its stepper, live price and dock, with every step after the first loaded on demand), so the assertion is pinned just above the heaviest page. It stops the number growing while the gap is worked down — it is not the budget. Lower the ceiling whenever a change wins headroom; never raise it without saying why in docs/PROGRESS.md.
